branch_profile_templates.directive_template: Treat {target_hypothesis} as the assigned challenger to {base_prediction}. Actively seek evidence that would support or refute {target_hypothesis}, especially roots that separate it from {base_prediction}.
Your assigned job is to resolve {base_prediction} versus {target_hypothesis}. Prefer evidence roots with high pairwise discriminator utility before broad exploration.
Assume the base answer {base_prediction} may be an anchoring error. Build the best evidence-grounded case for {target_hypothesis}, then abandon it only if the revealed ledger contradicts it.

notebook26_recommended_policy.reason: Observed branch trajectories are reused as offline alternatives; labels are used only for analysis of ceilings and policy curves. A live confirmation notebook is required before promotion.

decision_rule: Use a learned branch MLP to decide whether to branch; when it fires, compute target hypotheses from the base terminal graph/Bayes/MLP differential and assign each fresh LLM branch a distinct target plus discriminator roots.
leakage_rule: Labels and hidden full evidence are used only for metric computation. Branch trigger, branch prompts, and judge use current revealed evidence plus train/validate-derived graph/Bayes/MLP artifacts.
